Nice to meet you!      

 We’re a leader in data and AI. Through our software and services, we inspire customers around the world to transform data into intelligence – and questions into answers.   

 If you’re looking for a dynamic, fulfilling career with flexibility and a world-class employee experience, you’ll find it here. We’re recognized around the world for our inclusive, meaningful culture and innovative technologies by organizations like Fast Company, Forbes, Newsweek and more.  

 What you’ll do     

 Looking for *that* internship? The game-changing one that’ll help you learn, grow, and chart your path forward? You’ll find it at SAS. Our interns aren’t coffee runners – they do real, meaningful work. Our award-winning internship program is focused on development, culture, and community. We’ll help you grow professionally, find (or further) your passion, and make memorable connections that last beyond the summer.     

 The BOSS (Business Orchestration Services) team is building the next generation of SAS orchestration tools. We use cutting-edge architectures and languages to deliver world-class software that is a critical foundational component of multiple SAS solutions. It enables SAS products to ingest, enrich, and transform streaming data, and to orchestrate real-time data-driven decisioning processes.  

 As an intern, you might:  

• Add new components to the orchestration engine, enabling customers to integrate with additional third-party systems

• Add or modify functionality of the API (Application Programming Interface) to integrate the user interface with the back-end

• Write tests to confirm functionality and to compare performance with other systems

• Experiment with new capabilities in open-source data orchestration engines

• Participate in project scoping and tracking using the Agile methodology in a continuous delivery environment 

 Required qualifications  

• You’re an undergraduate college student enrolled in an accredited program, not graduating before December 2027 .    

• You have experience/coursework in Golang/Go 

• You’re interested in the future of analytics and embrace technology.  

• You’re curious, passionate, authentic, and accountable. These are Our SAS Values and influence everything we do.  

 Required qualifications  

• Experience with:

• Git 
 
• Performance tuning 
 
• Cloud technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, Azure, AWS) 

 Location  

• Cary, HQ Hybrid (minimum of 3 days in the office per week)  

 Timeline   

• Internship:  May 18, 2027 – August 6, 2027 (These dates are not flexible. To be considered for the SAS Summer Internship program, all interns must be available to start in person at Cary HQ on May 18, 2027. Summer internships last 12 weeks.   

 Perks of the job     

• Work with (and learn from) the best. As a SAS intern, you’ll get face time with company leaders and executives.    

• Hybrid work flexibility: Our hybrid approach offers the best of both worlds, combining in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work remotely, aligned with your team’s needs (minimum of 3 days in the office per week).    

• Free SAS programming training and certification.       

• Your well-being matters. We support all dimensions of your well-being with programs designed to reduce stress and distractions so you can stay healthy and productive. This includes an on-site Work/Life Center, Recreation and Fitness Center, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), subsidized cafés and more.     

• We work hard, but we like to have fun, too. Enjoy hackathons, social events and other opportunities to connect and engage.     

 You are welcome here.     

 At SAS, it’s not about fitting into our culture – it’s about adding to it. We believe our people make the difference. Our inclusive workforce brings together unique talents and inspires teams to create amazing software that reflects the diversity of our users and customers.    

 Additional Information     

 To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States, and should not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status. SAS is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by law. Read more: Know Your Rights.   

 Resumes may be considered in the order they are received. SAS employees performing certain job functions may require access to technology or software subject to export or import regulations. To comply with these regulations, SAS may obtain nationality or citizenship information from applicants for employment. SAS collects this information solely for trade law compliance purposes and does not use it to discriminate unfairly in the hiring process.    

  SAS only sends emails from verified “sas.com” email addresses and never asks for sensitive, personal information or money. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any type of communication from, or on behalf of SAS, please contact Recruitingsupport@sas.com.   

  Pay transparency: Hourly rates for SAS internships are based on an applicant’s year in school and the role they are hired into. Rates range from $15 to $30 per hour for associate and bachelor’s-level positions and from $29 to $49 per hour for master’s and Ph.D positions. Internship roles are not eligible for bonuses.   

 Let's stay in touch! Join our Talent Community to stay up to date on company news, job updates and more.  

 #LI-DNI

2027 Summer Internship | Software Engineering  
 School Year: Juniors or Seniors 
 Dates of the Internship: June 7th-August 13th 2027 (10 weeks) 
 Format: Hybrid in Chicago, Illinois  
 ( Camping World’s hybrid work model allows employees to work in the office Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, with the option to work from home on Thursday and Friday) 

 Overview 
 We're looking for an enthusiastic and curious Software Development Intern to join our IT team and contribute to real, impactful work. You'll get hands-on experience working on our subscription platform, building integrations, and using AI-assisted development tools to design, code, and test faster, all while learning how large-scale applications come together in a collaborative engineering environment. This is a great opportunity to grow your technical skills alongside experienced developers while making meaningful contributions from day one. 

 What You'll Do 
 
• Work on Our Subscription Platform — Contribute to our subscription platform and its related services and upstream systems, helping deliver features, fixes, and enhancements while learning how enterprise-scale systems fit together. 
• Develop with AI — Use AI coding assistants and agentic tools (such as GitHub Copilot and Claude) to write, refactor, test, and debug code. Learn to prompt effectively, validate AI output, and recognize when not to trust it. 
• Help Build & Test Integrations — Contribute to building and documenting integrations between the subscription platform, upstream systems, and third-party services, with guidance from senior engineers. 
• Learn & Apply Best Practices — Participate in code reviews, follow coding standards, and develop good habits around code quality, testing, and API design, including how to critically review and validate AI-generated code. 
• Collaborate Across Teams — Work alongside developers, product managers, and business analysts to understand how business requirements translate into technical solutions. 
• Troubleshoot & Investigate — Help investigate bugs and performance issues, using AI tools to speed up root-cause analysis while learning how to diagnose problems in real production systems. 
• Contribute to Documentation — Use AI tools to help draft and maintain technical documentation, reviewing it for accuracy to support the broader team. 
• Deliver an Intern Project — Own a well-scoped project over the 10 weeks, from planning through delivery, and present your results and learnings to the team at the end of the internship. 
 What We're Looking For 
 
• Currently pursuing or completing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field 
• Foundational knowledge of at least one programming language (C#, Java, or similar) 
• Curiosity about AI-assisted development tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or ChatGPT) and a willingness to use them responsibly and verify their output 
• Basic understanding of web technologies and RESTful APIs 
• Familiarity with databases and SQL fundamentals 
• Eagerness to learn, ask questions, and take on new challenges 
• Strong communication and collaboration skills 
 Nice to Have 
 
• Any exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) 
• Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants on class, personal, or open-source projects 
• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum workflows 
• Experience with front-end frameworks like React 
• Interest in subscription, e-commerce, or retail technology 
• Exposure to CI/CD concepts or version control (Git) 
 What You'll Gain 
 
• Hands-on experience using AI to build software on an enterprise-scale subscription platform 
• A real project to showcase, with the chance to present your work to the team 
• Practical guidance on using AI tools responsibly, including validating output, security, and data privacy 
• Mentorship from experienced engineers 
• Exposure to modern tools and technologies including AI-assisted development tools, cloud platforms, microservices, and integration patterns 
• A collaborative, supportive team environment where your contributions matter 
 General Compensation Disclosure 
 The pay range for this role considers several factors in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.   At Camping World, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the factors stated. A reasonable estimate of the current range is listed below.  

 Pay Range: 

 In addition to competitive pay, we offer Paid Time Off, 401(k), an Employee Assistance Program, Good Sam Roadside Assistance, discounts, paid parental leave (if eligibility is met), Tuition Reimbursement (if eligibility is met), and on the job training opportunities. Full-time associates are offered a comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, vision and more! Part-time associates are offered access to dental & vision coverage! For more information please visit: www.mycampingworldbenefits.com 
 
 We are an equal employment opportunity employer. The Company's policy is not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age (40 and over), disability, veteran or uniformed service-member status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

 School Year: Graduate Students   
 Dates of the Internship: June 7th-August 13th (10 weeks)  
 Format: Hybrid in Lincolnshire, Illinois   
 (Camping World’s hybrid work model allows employees to work in the office Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, with the option to work from home on Thursday and Friday).  
   
 About the role:  
 Camping World is looking for a Data Engineering intern for the summer of 2027 to work closely with the Data Management office. As an intern, you will assist with the daily operations and gain a first-hand Engineering experience. We are looking for someone who is driven, has experience in information technology, web development, software development and wants to be immersed in a real-world experience. If you are eager to learn, have a strong interest and want to further develop yourself as a professional; this is the ideal role for you.    
    
 Candidates must have the ability to work in our Chicago or Lincolnshire office on a hybrid basis (3 days in office, 2 days remote) for 10 weeks, beginning in June of 2027.  
   
 What You’ll Do:   
 
• Intern will partner with the DMO (Data Management Office) team which would include the following task/assignments.    
• Data Engineering - engineering tasks which will require SQL and Snowflake skills     
• Data Validation - comparing and verifying source and target data    
• Business Acumen - This would be a great opportunity to learn various aspects of automotive, retail and Digital business.    
• Complete software development in collaboration with data scientists, data analyst, solution architects, data engineers, managerial and leadership roles    
• Handle new source data requests from the business   
• Take on individual special projects as needed to enhance your knowledge and skills

• Sufficient knowledge of Microsoft Office: Suite: (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)   
• Experience with software and web development    
• Excellent troubleshooting, data interpreting, and technical skills   
• Knowledge in Information technology (databases, system security, trouble shooting, etc.)    
• Ability to maintain professional demeanor and strict confidentiality    
• Must be diligent, organized, and extremely detail-oriented   
• Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment    
• Analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills and passion for data analytics   
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
